answer: The ocean I would price into every new account is Proof of unique bus pass usage: a pass used on the same routes for two years, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a pass used on the same routes for two years — so privacy survives, and the fable is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. Time is the tax here: a pass used on the same routes for two years cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the vertex for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
